constraints.description: The provider fields use one track below the measured 36rem provider-panel boundary and two tracks above it and at restored desktop width without viewport-breakpoint coupling or horizontal overflow.

validation.validation_method: Focused class contract plus authorized Playwright computed-track and bounding-box assertions

constraints.description: Enable, Base URL, Protocol, API Key, reveal, and Default Model remain mechanically keyboard reachable with visible focus, while a dirty Base URL survives all layout transitions and no durable write occurs.

validation.validation_method: Authorized Playwright focus, dirty-value, scroll-viewport, and zero-write assertions

constraints.description: The change preserves the existing settings hook and draft cache and adds no width state, effect, subscription, provider data mutation, service, store, transport, realtime, or unload behavior.

validation.validation_method: Exact production diff and changed-file scope inspection

constraints.description: Tier 0 through Tier 3 results, the development-optimizer limitation, full-suite baseline failures, OpenSpec delta, and artifact limitations are recorded without representing unrelated failures as passes.

validation.validation_method: Command receipts, strict OpenSpec validation, artifact schema validation, manifest integrity, and KBD execution evidence

constraints.description: No unrequested production source, dependency, provider compatibility, realtime, unload-dialog, state-authority, or unrelated baseline-repair work belongs to this change.

validation.validation_method: Scoped diff inventory, exact production hunk inspection, and independent diff-mode adversarial review

global_rules: Use the OpenSpec proposal, delta, design, and tasks as acceptance authority.
Keep the production edit class-only and retain incumbent tokens, markup, copy, state, and behavior.
Do not repair unrelated full-suite, Vite optimizer, dependency, provider, realtime, or unload behavior in this change.
Do not claim the development-server attempt passed; certification is the authorized production-bundle Playwright pass.
termination_conditions: All five blocking constraints have observed deterministic evidence.
Manifest, constraints, referenced files, iteration history, strict OpenSpec, and diff integrity validate.
Fresh isolated diff-mode adversarial review has no critical finding and passes the anti-theater gate.
